# EPIC-KITCHENS-55

Original first-person kitchen action release with an action anticipation task.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** A first-person clip ending before the next kitchen action begins.

**Output / label:** The upcoming verb and object category.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://epic-kitchens.github.io/2018)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://epic-kitchens.github.io/2018)

## Intention in this dataset

Predict the next annotated verb-noun action before its onset. Action labels are behavioral proxies rather than explicit intention labels.

**Relevance:** `implicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2018

**Domains:** daily_activities, human_object_interaction  
**Intention types:** action, object_interaction  
**Tasks:** action_anticipation  
**Modalities:** rgb, audio  
**Formats:** video, structured_annotation, text
